kjv: But thou (Yahweh) hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us
mine: unless You (Yahweh) have utterly rejected us, and You remain exceedingly angry with us
note: Hebrew ki 'im is most naturally "unless" or "even if", leaving the book's last line as an anxious qualification of the prayer in v. 21; the KJV's "but" makes it a flat statement of rejection.
